summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K to report a press release announcing submission of a Prior Approval Supplement to the FDA to expand the approved age range for KHINDIVI (hydrocortisone) oral solution to include children under five. This is a routine regulatory milestone for an existing product, not a special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or capitalization event. No deal terms, prices, or strategic alternatives are involved. The update is operational and product-focused, with potential FDA approval expected in first half 2027, but no special-situation classification applies.
